He said: I will not believe until I touch the nails. ✋ John 20

Thomas missed the first time Jesus appeared to the disciples. When they told him “We have seen the Lord” (John 20:25), he refused to believe without proof. Eight days later Jesus stood in the room and said: “Reach hither thy finger, and behold my hands” (John 20:27). Thomas answered: “My Lord and my God” (John 20:28).

Jesus called you blessed if you believe without seeing. What's one thing that helps you believe on hard days? 👇

They threw three men into the fire. The king counted four. 🔥 Daniel 3

Shadrach, Meshach and Abed-nego would not bow to the golden image. Their answer to the king: “But if not, be it known unto thee, O king, that we will not serve thy gods” (Daniel 3:18). Then the king saw “four men loose, walking in the midst of the fire” (Daniel 3:25).

What's your “but if not” this week? 👇

Gratitude is a discipline. 🖤🦃

4 ways to lock in your faith this Thanksgiving week: thank Him first thing in the morning (Psalm 92:2), train your soul harder than your body (1 Timothy 4:8), pray with thanks even on the hard days (Philippians 4:6), and don't let the break break your streak.

Which one do you need most? Comment 1 to 4 👇

He was taken up, and they could not stop staring at the sky. ☁️ Acts 1

For forty days the risen Jesus was seen by his disciples. Then “he was taken up; and a cloud received him out of their sight” (Acts 1:9). Two men in white asked them: “why stand ye gazing up into heaven?” (Acts 1:11) This same Jesus will come back.

Who's one person you could tell about Jesus this week? 👇

God told him: ask what I shall give thee. He didn't ask for money. 👑 1 Kings 3

Young King Solomon had a dream at Gibeon. God said: “Ask what I shall give thee” (1 Kings 3:5). Solomon asked: “Give therefore thy servant an understanding heart to judge thy people” (1 Kings 3:9). God gave him wisdom, and also “that which thou hast not asked, both riches, and honour” (1 Kings 3:13).

If God asked you tonight, what would you ask for? 👇
